title: Silent Checkout Conversion Drop ($18k/hr Loss) vs. Red-Herring Deploy v3.4.2
symptom_summary: Storefront checkout conversion dropped sharply starting at 2026-10-22T14:05:00Z. On-call suspects checkout-service deployment v3.4.2 shipped today, and merchants brightmart and kairo-shop opened urgent tickets about iPhone payment failures.

red_herrings.why_plausible: Shipped during the incident window and touched payment logging
red_herrings.why_falsified: Temporal precedence violation: anomaly began at 14:05:00Z (15 minutes before dep-1005)

red_herrings.why_plausible: Preceded the anomaly by 25 minutes on checkout-service
red_herrings.why_falsified: Cohort isolation check: Android and Web checkouts sharing cfg-301 had 0.00% failure rate

ground_truth_root_cause.description: Feature flag stripe_intent_v2 enabled to 100% of ios & app_version >= 2.1.0 at 2026-10-22T14:04:00Z
ground_truth_root_cause.mechanism: iOS client v2.1.0 omits mandate_data when stripe_intent_v2=true, triggering HTTP 422 payment_intent_unprocessable
